scope: AlgEngine only. Original model geometry/loss/freezing, FP32. Real mini overrides do not accept original data proportions or convergence.

inference.acceptance: Independent small-data inference; exported cached metrics still require separate official NAVSIM rescoring. No GPU comparison or full-benchmark claim.
inference.dataset_scope: Real NAVTEST subset split by log for adaptation training and independent small-data evaluation; not full official benchmark

perception_hour.iteration_time_scope: From before_train_iter through forward/backward/optimizer/monitoring; excludes batch fetching. End-to-end timing includes it and checkpointing.
perception_hour.data_scope: Repeated 42-anchor real mini, 8xB1 with sampler padding; exposure count is not unique dataset size or full NAVTRAIN convergence.
perception_hour.acceptance: Bounded isolated-hour FP32 native full perception geometry/loss/optimizer/warmup. No leak exclusion, 24h, full-data, AMP or GPU speed comparison claim.

perception_inference.acceptance: Functional original detection/mapping inference on mini frames. Full detection/mapping quality and GPU comparison are separate acceptance items.

perception_hour_checkpoint_inference.acceptance: Functional original detection/mapping inference on mini frames. Full detection/mapping quality and GPU comparison are separate acceptance items.

all_parameter_sync.scope: Read-only post-run parameter audit on the unchanged final source. Does not assert equality of rank-local nonparameter buffers or algorithm quality.

strict_operator_reference.scope: CPU64 diagnoses coordinate arithmetic; does not replace independent GPU/model quality acceptance.

cpu_memory.scope: Real-mini 8-rank perception, charged memory including cache. Full NAVTRAIN not measured.
